content:
_Ever wanted to secure your house entrance and restrict any mobs from opening doors? Well, now you can._ → _是否曾想过保护你的房屋入口，阻止任何生物开门？现在就可以。_

This mod simply adds Vanilla-friendly copper pressure plates which can be triggered **only** by players. → 本模组仅添加了与原版兼容的铜质压力板，且**只有**玩家才能触发它们。

- Copper pressure plates weather through all vanilla stages: `Unaffected` → `Exposed` → `Weathered` → `Oxidized` → - 铜质压力板会经历所有原版氧化阶段：`未受影响的` → `暴露的` → `风化的` → `氧化的`
- Plates can be waxed by right-clicking with a honeycomb in hand, just like vanilla copper blocks → - 手持蜂巢右键点击压力板即可为其涂蜡，与原版铜块相同
- Waxing is also available via crafting table by combining a plate with a honeycomb → - 也可以通过工作台将压力板与蜂巢组合来涂蜡
- All waxed variants can be unwaxed by scraping with an axe → - 所有涂蜡变体均可通过斧头刮擦去除蜡层

Crafting is affordable and reasonable: → 合成配方经济合理：

| Default | Already Waxed | → | 默认 | 已涂蜡 |
| ... | ... | ... | ... | ... |
| ![Crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0ac1fdef31ce0e40d4c0175d9f3251383d8d025.png) | ![Crafting recipe with wax](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bceb3647c7690727a2d86ea0983149168821751c.png) | → | ![合成配方](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0ac1fdef31ce0e40d4c0175d9f3251383d8d025.png) | ![带蜡的合成配方](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bceb3647c7690727a2d86ea0983149168821751c.png) |

> Modpack usage is available as long as you give credit. → > 只要注明出处，即可在整合包中使用本模组。
